resources.string: You can now create new lists directly from inside a group dashboard, saving you from having to create and move them.
Overhauled the deletion mechanism with safe \"soft-deletion\" to ensure perfect background synchronization and data recovery.
Dashboard budget cards now update instantly and flawlessly when you cut or copy budget records between lists.
Deleted lists will no longer erroneously appear as available targets when you copy or cut records.
Centralized dialogs and bulk operations into a unified engine for a faster, more reliable application experience.
